title.original: Holistic Agent Leaderboard: The Missing Infrastructure for AI Agent Evaluation
title.zh: 综合智能体排行榜：AI 智能体评测中缺失的基础设施
title.en: Holistic Agent Leaderboard: The Missing Infrastructure for AI Agent Evaluation

inclusion_reason.zh: HAL 的 VM 调度、标准 Runner、全日志采集和三维分析形成跨模型、Scaffold 与基准的共享评测基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: HAL's VM scheduling, standard runner, full log capture, and three-axis analysis form shared evaluation infrastructure across models, scaffolds, and benchmarks.

abstract.zh: Holistic Agent Leaderboard（HAL）提供跨数百 VM 并行运行的标准评测 Harness，并联合分析模型、Agent Scaffold 与基准三个维度。
abstract.en: The Holistic Agent Leaderboard (HAL) provides a standardized harness running evaluations across hundreds of VMs and jointly analyzes models, agent scaffolds, and benchmarks.

problem.zh: Agent 评测实现各异、运行周期长且易含基础设施错误，排行榜又常把模型和 Scaffold 的影响混在一个分数里。
problem.en: Agent evaluations differ in implementation, take too long, and contain infrastructure bugs, while leaderboards conflate model and scaffold effects in one score.

approach.zh: HAL 统一环境与执行接口，大规模并行 rollout，并保存完整日志用于 LLM 辅助行为审计和三维对照实验。
approach.en: HAL standardizes environments and execution interfaces, parallelizes rollouts, and retains full logs for LLM-assisted behavior audits and three-way comparisons.

system_design.zh: 控制面向 VM 队列分发模型—Scaffold—基准组合，采集器记录工具与模型调用，分析层聚合指标并对异常轨迹做日志检查。
system_design.en: A control plane dispatches model-scaffold-benchmark combinations to VM queues, captures tool/model calls, aggregates metrics, and inspects anomalous traces.

key_results.zh: 大规模运行把评测时间从周缩到小时，并发现更高推理投入并非总能提高准确率，以及搜索基准答案等未报告行为。
key_results.en: Large-scale execution cuts evaluation from weeks to hours and uncovers that more reasoning effort often fails to improve accuracy, alongside behaviors such as searching for benchmark solutions.

limitations.zh: Harness 统一性不能修复底层基准语义，LLM 日志检查也可能漏报；大规模闭源模型运行具有显著成本与可复现性约束。
limitations.en: Harness standardization cannot repair flawed benchmark semantics, LLM log inspection may miss behavior, and large closed-model runs carry cost and reproducibility constraints.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
